email.subject: Application accepted
email.html_body:
Hello {{{user.first_name}}} {{{user.last_name}}}!

Your application to vote online has been accepted successfully.

You can now use {{{user.email}}} as username to login and the provided password during registration.

{{#if election}}You are registered for {{election.name}}.
{{#if election.opening}}Voting opens: {{datetime_zone election.opening output_format="%-d %B %Y, %H:%M" style="voter"}}
{{/if}}{{#if election.close}}Voting closes: {{datetime_zone election.close electionEventTimezone output_format="%-d %B %Y, %H:%M" style="voter"}}{{#eq electionTimezone electionEventTimezone}}{{else}} ({{datetime_zone election.close output_format="%H:%M" style="voter"}}){{/eq}}
{{/if}}
{{/if}}

Login Link



Regards,

sms.message: Hello {{{user.first_name}}} {{{user.last_name}}}. Your application to vote online has been accepted successfully. You can now use your phone_number as username to login and the provided password during registration. Login link: {{{vote_url}}}

email.subject: Ang aplikasyon ay tinanggap
email.html_body:
Kumusta {{{user.first_name}}} {{{user.last_name}}}!

Ang iyong aplikasyon para sa online voting ay tinanggap nang matagumpay.

Maaari mo nang gamitin ang {{{user.email}}} bilang username para mag-login at ang password na ibinigay sa panahon ng pagpaparehistro.

{{#if election}}Nakarehistro ka para sa {{election.name}}.
{{#if election.opening}}Magbubukas ang pagboto: {{datetime_zone election.opening output_format="%-d %B %Y, %H:%M" style="voter"}}
{{/if}}{{#if election.close}}Magsasara ang pagboto: {{datetime_zone election.close electionEventTimezone output_format="%-d %B %Y, %H:%M" style="voter"}}{{#eq electionTimezone electionEventTimezone}}{{else}} ({{datetime_zone election.close output_format="%H:%M" style="voter"}}){{/eq}}
{{/if}}
{{/if}}

Link sa Login



Mabuting araw,
